notes: Meshy multi-image generation uses the front/back/left/right references from this set.

views.label: Front
views.prompt: Create a clean product reference image for the same premium technical waterproof rain jacket. No human model, no mannequin, no text, no logo, no UI labels, no background clutter. Garment details: hood up, full front waterproof zipper, shoulder pocket, sealed seams, matte dark navy charcoal ripstop waterproof fabric, adjustable cuffs, adjustable waist, realistic technical apparel construction. The jacket must look identical across the full turnaround set: same proportions, same pocket placement, same seam layout, same fabric texture, same charcoal navy color. Required view: strict front orthographic view, centered, arms relaxed, zipper visible from hood to hem. Plain light gray studio background, soft realistic lighting, complete garment in frame, no cropping, no dramatic fashion pose.
